terms.definition: The measure of how much magnetic field passes through a surface, equal to B A cos theta for a uniform field, in webers.
A changing magnetic flux through a loop induces an emf equal in size to the rate of change of flux.
The emf induced in a conductor moving through a magnetic field, equal to B l v for a rod moving at right angles to the field.
